basis: Native facade/site/water traces, six actually inspected dated local originals and reported Qualla overall height. No measured architectural drawing or construction-survey claim.
reportedHeightSource: Local Qualla article trevi-fountain-wp, source Wikipedia; comparative visual control, not independently surveyed.

nativeGeometry.axis: +X follows mapped Palazzo Poli fountain facade toward east-northeast; +Z points out across basin toward south-southeast; +Y up from independently sampled dry outer Piazza di Trevi path contact.

limitations: Rockwork position, water/step levels, statue shapes and cornice/column dimensions are photographic estimates. Submerged basin construction/floor is simplified closed support; no bathymetry/plumbing reproduction.

District preserves thick sculptural profiles; street/close have full posed volumes. Skyline intentionally merges small columns, ornament, figures and ledges while retaining overall architecture and basin silhouette.
